━━━ /bank ━━━
(sends)
🏦 Bank - Ostmarch branch

💵 Cash: 5,000 Nil
🏦 Bank balance: 0 Nil
Withdrawals here carry a fee of 1.5%, taken from your bank on top of the amount; deposits are free.

📤 Your bank balance is too low to withdraw.
Choose an amount below; for any other amount, press "any amount" and type it.

💸 To give money to another player, reply to their message in the group with "pay 5000", or press "Pay a player".
  ───
  [📥 Deposit 1,000 Nil] → bank:deposit:1000:idxba   │   [📥 Deposit 5,000 Nil] → bank:deposit:5000:idxxca
  [✏️ Deposit any amount] → ask:bank.deposit
  [💸 Pay a player] → bank:pay   │   [🏛 National bank] → loan:hub
  [🔙 Back] → player:profile.get   │   [🔄 Refresh] → bank:show

━━━ /pay ━━━
(sends)
💸 Pay another player
• In a group: reply to their message with "pay 5000".
• Here: send "pay" with their username or player code, for example "pay @username" or "pay K7Q2M9A".
Cash changes hands only when you are both in the same city; card payments work from anywhere.
  ───
  [🔎 Find a player] → social:search
  [🔙 Back] → bank:show
